Opzetten van Pipelines en Azure DevOps; Opstellen van automatisering (Bicep) voor de provisioning van Azure services; Toepassen van recommended practices; Continu optimaliseren van de Azure omgeving voor Pensioenbeheer Nieuwe technologieën vertaal je naar bruikbare bouwblokken in de Azure Foundation. Energie~ Je brengt enthousiasme, ondernemerschap en initiatief in het team en helpt collega’s om samen de finishlijn te halen. Eigenaarschap~ Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaten, bewaakt het IT-beleid en zorgt dat technische oplossingen voldoen aan de functionele behoeften en kwaliteitseisen van de organisatie. Uiteraard valt er nog meer te vertellen over deze functie, dat vertellen we je graag tijdens een kennismaking. Binnen deze afdeling zijn ongeveer 25 DevOps teams werkzaam. Er zijn verschillende afdelingen betrokken bij de cloud transitie. Je hebt te maken met de centrale IT teams die verantwoordelijk zijn voor zaken als de basis Azure inrichting voor PGGM, netwerk en identity. En daarnaast heb je te maken met de teams die we ondersteunen, de PB-IT DevOps teams. Wil je je verder ontwikkelen en doorgroeien, dan krijg je daar alle ondersteuning voor. Dat ervaart ook Orrin Rijk, die bij het team IT Infrastructuur werkt~ “In mijn vorige baan zat niet veel vooruitgang. Hier werk ik nog maar twee jaar en ben ik al een stuk verder gekomen. HBO werk- en denkniveau, met minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare en relevante werkervaring op het gebied van IT Infrastructuur (specifiek Cloud toepassingen) Aantoonbare ruime ervaring met Microsoft Cloud-oplossingen (Azure). In staat om technische ontwerpen te implementeren in Azure. Communicatieve vaardigheden. Je bent in staat aan zowel technische als niet-technische collega’s je boodschap helder te communiceren. Gezond kritische houding, je denkt in oplossingen maar verliest daarbij risico’s en beveiligingsaspecten nooit uit het oog. Team player die uitstekend weet om te gaan met een complex speelveld aan stakeholders. Je kiest voor de juiste balans tussen kwaliteit en snel resultaat. Secure by design is voor jou een gegeven. Wij bieden Bij PGGM zijn we trots op onze kernwaarden~ vertrouwen, teamwork en innovatie. Deze waarden zijn ontstaan uit de ‘best stories’ van onze collega's, momenten waarop zij op hun best waren. Jaarlijks een Fit for the Future budget van € 300,- netto welke je kunt inzetten voor het verbeteren van de mentale, fysieke of financiële fitheid. Een ruim opleidingsbudget voor interne en externe trainingen of opleidingen. Ruim 26 vakantiedagen (medewerkers hebben de keuze om maximaal twee nationale christelijke feestdagen te ruilen met een voor hen belangrijke (feest)dag). Flexibiliteit in werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Een netto internetvergoeding van € 45,- per maand (€ 540,- per jaar). Collectiviteitskorting op de aanvullende zorgverzekeringen. Een thuiswerkregeling met een vergoeding van max. € 900,- incl. btw om je thuiswerkplek arbo-proof in te richten. Neem dan contact met ons op! PGGM en hybride werken Bij PGGM hebben we een hybride werkomgeving gecreëerd die ons in staat stelt om flexibiliteit en samenwerking te combineren. Onze medewerkers hebben de mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als op afstand te werken, afhankelijk van hun persoonlijke voorkeuren en de aard van hun werk. Door hybride werken aan te bieden, willen we onze medewerkers de vrijheid geven om hun eigen werkstijl te ontwikkelen, maar tegelijkertijd de voordelen van een gezamenlijke werkplek behouden. PGGM vindt het belangrijk dat dit zorgvuldig, vertrouwelijk, transparant en met in achtneming van de algemene verordening gegevensbescherming en aanverwante wet-en regelgeving plaatsvindt. review_candidates.title: Project Coordinator (IT Projects) - Virtually Support Clients in USA
review_candidates.description: Company Information At Bit By Bit, we've been helping organizations thrive since 1987. Originally founded as a database application development and networking company, we've grown into a full-service IT firm and a recognized leader in delivering reliable, cost-effective managed IT services across the Tri-State area. Our team specializes in building and managing solutions that solve critical business challenges. With a unique blend of business technology expertise, certified technicians, and proven processes, we provide our clients with tailored IT solutions that improve productivity, strengthen security, streamline communications, and reduce costs. Beyond technology, our culture is rooted in humility and curiosity, and our vision is simple: to help untangle people and process challenges so businesses can move forward with confidence. Role Summary We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to help keep multiple client technology projects moving from planning through execution and handoff. You will work closely with project managers, engineers, service teams, vendors, and clients to coordinate resources, track milestones and dependencies, maintain project documentation, communicate status, and ensure next steps are clear and completed. This is not simply an administrative coordination role. You will be part of the team responsible for moving real client IT projects forward in a fast-paced MSP environment. The role offers broad exposure to project delivery, client communication, technical teams, and the operating rhythms of a U.S.-based technology services company. Work Arrangement Remote position based in the Philippines or Indonesia. Full-time schedule aligned with U.S. Eastern Time (9:00 AM - 6:00 PM ET), which means nighttime working hours in the Philippines and Indonesia. Regular interaction with U.S.-based clients, engineers, project leaders, and other internal teams. Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote working environment are required. What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and next actions. Engineers and other contributors know what they are responsible for and when their work is scheduled. Clients receive timely, professional, and easy-to-understand updates. Risks, delays, and stalled tasks are identified early and escalated appropriately. Project documentation is accurate, current, and easy for others to use. Completed projects transition cleanly into ongoing support with proper documentation and knowledge transfer. Project managers can rely on you to independently follow up, organize work, and keep projects moving. Duties and Responsibilities Project Coordination & Delivery Support project initiation, scope clarification, and Statement of Work (SOW) documentation for multiple client projects simultaneously. Coordinate resources across project engineering, service desk, NOC/SOC, vendors, and other internal teams to support project execution. Track milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, action items, and decisions using project management tools. Maintain clear ownership and next actions across projects and proactively follow up with responsible parties. Identify stalled work, missed commitments, resource conflicts, or emerging risks and escalate them before they affect delivery. Assist with project budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, and tracking work against financial expectations. Coordinate engineering time with resource/dispatch teams and help resolve scheduling conflicts. Support project meetings by preparing agendas, documenting decisions, capturing action items, and following through on commitments. MSP Operational Alignment Ensure project work is properly logged, scheduled, and tracked through the MSP's project management, PSA, ticketing, and related operational systems. Maintain awareness of client SLAs and operational commitments so project activity does not unnecessarily disrupt ongoing support. Work with the PMO and project leaders to follow project governance, change management, documentation, security, and data-handling standards. Coordinate device provisioning, deployments, migrations, upgrades, and other implementation activities as required by the project plan. Support clean handoffs from project teams to service desk/operations after completion, including documentation, asset updates, open issues, and knowledge transfer. Client & Stakeholder Communication Act as a communication bridge between clients, project managers, engineers, vendors, and internal service teams. Provide clear and timely project updates covering progress, upcoming milestones, risks, decisions, and changes to timelines. Communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based clients through email, Microsoft Teams, and project meetings. Translate project status and technical information into clear, client-friendly language. Follow up on client decisions, approvals, questions, and commitments that may affect project timelines. Help manage expectations across client leadership and technical teams while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Documentation, Quality & Closeout Prepare and maintain client-facing project documentation, runbooks, SOPs, schedules, meeting notes, and status reports. Support user acceptance testing (UAT), final validation, and readiness activities where applicable. Ensure project closeout activities are completed, including documentation updates, ticket closure, asset updates, outstanding-item tracking, and lessons learned. Help ensure final deliverables and documentation meet agreed project and internal quality standards. Requirements Required Qualifications 2-4+ years of experience in project coordination, project administration, or project management, ideally in technology or professional services. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple projects or workstreams at the same time while maintaining attention to detail. Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based clients and colleagues. Strong organizational, follow-up, prioritization, and time-management skills. Comfort working with technical professionals and learning the terminology and workflow of IT projects. Experience using a project management, ticketing, PSA, workflow, or task-tracking platform. Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and stalled work and take appropriate action rather than waiting for direction. Ability to work independently in a distributed team while remaining responsive, collaborative, and accountable. Ability and willingness to work a full-time schedule aligned with U.S. Eastern Time. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP), IT services company, or other client-facing technology environment. Experience with project management platform and software. Familiarity with PSA/RMM or service management tools such as ConnectWise, Autotask, N-able, Kaseya, NinjaOne, or similar platforms. Understanding of MSP workflows, SLAs, ticketing, asset management, change management, and service handoffs. Exposure to Microsoft 365, Azure, networking, cloud, infrastructure, device deployment, or migration projects. CAPM, PMP, or other formal project management training/certification. Professional Competencies Ownership and follow-through: you do not let tasks disappear after a meeting or email. Client orientation: you communicate professionally and understand that the client experience matters as much as the project plan. Judgment: you know when to solve, when to follow up, and when to escalate. Attention to detail: project records, dates, dependencies, and documentation stay accurate. Adaptability: you can shift priorities in a fast-moving MSP environment without losing control of existing commitments. Teamwork: you collaborate effectively across technical, service, project, vendor, and client teams. Benefits Compensation & Benefits Salary: Philippines: $1,300-1,800 USD/month Indonesia: $1000-1,500 USD/month Two weeks paid vacation Additional Indonesia benefits include medical, dental, paid vacation, and retirement plan Working Conditions Location: Fully Remote Schedule: Full-time overnight shift aligned with Eastern Time (USA) Environment: Fast-paced MSP environment supporting multiple client infrastructures and enterprise systems Occasional after-hours or on-call responsibilities may be required
